IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL EXECUTION, REAL-DATA RECOVERY, OUTREACH CONTROL, AND PRODUCTION VERIFICATION

EXECUTE THIS BLOCK NOW. DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER NARRATIVE REPORT.

The forensic report states that test investors and fake financial metrics were removed. That is only the beginning. Complete the full production workflow end to end and prove that every number, investor, outreach action, autonomous run, deployment, and dashboard record is real.

==================================================
1. FREEZE FAKE DATA IMMEDIATELY
==================================================

Block all future creation or display of:

- Fake investors
- Demo investors
- Seeded CRM contacts
- Test buyers
- Test commitments
- Simulated wires
- Fake revenue
- Fake closed deals
- Fake outreach counts
- Fake autonomous activity
- Placeholder pipeline values
- Calculated “capital seeking” displayed as investor commitments

Add permanent database fields:

- data_origin
- verification_status
- financial_status
- outreach_status
- source_record_id
- created_by
- created_at
- verified_at
- verified_by
- evidence_url
- audit_trace_id

Allowed data_origin values:

- production_registration
- imported_verified
- owner_created
- partner_source
- public_business_source
- test

Test records must never appear in production dashboards.

==================================================
2. SEPARATE FUNDING TARGETS FROM REAL INVESTOR MONEY
==================================================

The Executive Layer must display these as separate values:

A. Capital Being Sought
- Funding requested by IVX deals
- Not investor money
- Not committed money
- Not pipeline money

B. Identified Investor Prospects
- Real people or companies
- Contact information verified
- No commitment implied

C. Contacted Investors
- Outreach actually sent
- Include timestamp, channel and delivery status

D. Interested Investors
- Investor replied or completed an interest form

E. Qualified Investors
- Identity and qualification reviewed
- KYC/AML status visible

F. Committed Capital
- Written commitment exists
- Evidence attached

G. Funds Received
- Actual reconciled transaction
- Bank, escrow or payment evidence attached

Never combine these categories into one “Investor Pipeline” number.

==================================================
3. AUDIT ALL 1,043 INVESTOR RECORDS
==================================================

Review every investor prospect one by one.

For each record verify:

- Full name
- Company
- Role
- Email
- Phone
- Website
- Location
- Investor category
- Investment range
- Preferred asset type
- Source
- Source URL
- Duplicate status
- Contact validity
- Outreach eligibility
- Consent or legal basis
- KYC status
- Last contact
- Owner approval status

Classify every record:

- VERIFIED_REAL
- REAL_UNVERIFIED_CONTACT
- DUPLICATE
- INVALID
- TEST
- DO_NOT_CONTACT
- NEEDS_OWNER_REVIEW

Delete or quarantine all TEST and INVALID records.

Do not count unverified contacts as qualified investors.

==================================================
4. OUTREACH APPROVAL GATE
==================================================

Do not automatically send outreach to all 1,043 records.

Create an owner approval queue with:

- Investor name
- Company
- Contact channel
- Source
- Why the investor matches
- Proposed message
- Deal being presented
- Legal/compliance status
- Risk flags
- Approve
- Reject
- Edit
- Approve batch

No message may be sent without an immutable approval record unless the owner has explicitly enabled an approved automation campaign.

Add campaign limits:

- Daily sending cap
- Per-domain cap
- Retry limit
- Bounce suppression
- Unsubscribe handling
- Do-not-contact list
- Duplicate-message prevention
- Time-zone-aware sending
- Full sent/delivered/replied/bounced audit trail

==================================================
5. VERIFY THE THREE REAL DEALS
==================================================

Audit and verify the production records for:

- Perez Residence
- Casa Rosario
- One Stop

For each deal confirm:

- Correct deal ID
- Correct title
- Funding target
- Capital already committed
- Capital received
- Remaining requirement
- Property data
- Images and videos
- Investor documents
- Returns model
- Risk disclosures
- Owner approval
- Public/private visibility
- Correct dashboard totals

Do not display a project funding target as investor interest.

==================================================
6. FINANCIAL LEDGER RECONCILIATION
==================================================

Create a production financial ledger that is independent from CRM scoring.

Required transaction statuses:

- projected
- requested
- soft_commitment
- signed_commitment
- pending_wire
- escrow_received
- bank_received
- returned
- cancelled

Only escrow_received or bank_received may count as “Funds Received.”

Every committed or received amount must include:

- Investor ID
- Deal ID
- Amount
- Currency
- Transaction status
- Date
- Supporting document
- Reconciliation status
- Approved by
- Audit trace ID

Current dashboard values must remain:

- Committed Capital: $0 unless documentary proof exists
- Funds Received: $0 unless reconciled proof exists
- Raised This Month: $0 unless reconciled proof exists

==================================================
7. AUTONOMOUS RUN VERIFICATION
==================================================

The report states 439 autonomous runs were real.

Verify every run contains:

- Agent name
- Task ID
- Start time
- End time
- Input
- Action performed
- Tools called
- Records changed
- Output
- Error state
- Evidence
- Commit or deployment reference
- Owner approval requirement
- Final result

A scheduled job that performs no real action must not be counted as productive work.

Create dashboard categories:

- Completed with evidence
- Completed without evidence
- Failed
- Retrying
- Waiting for approval
- No action
- Cancelled

==================================================
8. AI ARCHITECTURE MAPPING
==================================================

Generate a live end-to-end map showing:

OWNER / USER
↓
EXPO NATIVE APP
↓
OWNER AUTHENTICATION
↓
IVX AI CHAT
↓
AI ROUTER
↓
TASK CLASSIFIER
↓
PERMISSION CHECK
↓
APPROVAL GATE
↓
TOOL EXECUTION
↓
GITHUB / RENDER / SUPABASE / AWS / EMAIL / CRM
↓
QA VALIDATION
↓
EVIDENCE LEDGER
↓
OWNER DASHBOARD
↓
PRODUCTION RESPONSE

For every AI agent show:

- Agent name
- Responsibility
- Status
- Input
- Output
- Tools
- Permissions
- Database tables
- Current task
- Last successful execution
- Last error
- Evidence
- Completion percentage

Clearly mark:

- VERIFIED LIVE
- IMPLEMENTED BUT NOT VERIFIED
- PARTIAL
- NOT IMPLEMENTED
- DISABLED

==================================================
9. EXPO APP IS THE ONLY MOBILE PRODUCT
==================================================

Verify that the Expo React Native application is the only authorized mobile product.

Complete:

- Remove duplicate mobile applications
- Remove obsolete Vercel-only app flows
- Remove Rork banners and SDK dependencies
- Confirm Android and iOS use the same backend
- Confirm owner dashboard is part of the authorized IVX product
- Confirm GitHub repository belongs to the owner
- Confirm production deployment comes from the approved repository and branch

Do not delete infrastructure required by the Expo app without first proving it is unused.

==================================================
10. OWNER AUTHENTICATION QA
==================================================

Test on Android, iOS and web:

- Manual owner login
- Invalid password rejection
- Logout
- Login again
- Restart persistence
- Expired session handling
- Owner-role enforcement
- Non-owner rejection
- Admin Hub access
- Variables access
- Investors access
- Financial ledger access
- Outreach approval access
- Autonomous dashboard access
- Audit ledger access

Provide screenshots, logs, timestamps and trace IDs.

==================================================
11. PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Deploy all verified corrections.

Required evidence:

- GitHub repository
- Branch
- Commit SHA
- Files changed
- Pull request or commit link
- Render service
- Render deployment ID
- Deployment status
- Build logs
- Database migration IDs
- Expo EAS Android build ID
- Expo EAS iOS build ID, if available
- Installable APK
- Production URLs
- /health HTTP 200
- Live commit shown by /health
- GitHub HEAD equals live production commit

==================================================
12. REQUIRED DATABASE VERIFICATION
==================================================

Audit the live production tables for:

- members
- investors
- buyers
- properties
- deals
- commitments
- transactions
- outreach_campaigns
- outreach_messages
- autonomous_runs
- agent_tasks
- approvals
- audit_logs
- financial_ledger
- evidence_ledger

Return:

- Table name
- Production row count
- Test row count
- Invalid row count
- Duplicate row count
- Verified real row count
- Last updated timestamp

==================================================
13. REQUIRED DASHBOARD CORRECTIONS
==================================================

The Executive Layer must show:

- Capital Being Sought
- Verified Investor Prospects
- Prospects Awaiting Verification
- Outreach Awaiting Approval
- Outreach Sent
- Replies Received
- Qualified Investors
- Signed Commitments
- Funds Received
- Active Deals
- Open Risks
- Autonomous Tasks Completed With Evidence
- Failed Autonomous Tasks
- Current Production Version

Every number must be clickable and traceable to the exact underlying records.

==================================================
14. ACCEPTANCE TESTS
==================================================

This task is complete only when all tests pass:

[ ] No test investor appears in production
[ ] No fake amount appears in production
[ ] Funding targets are separated from investor money
[ ] Every dashboard total opens its source records
[ ] All 1,043 investor records are classified
[ ] Invalid and test records are quarantined
[ ] Outreach requires owner approval
[ ] No duplicate outreach can be sent
[ ] Replies are stored and visible
[ ] Commitments require documentation
[ ] Funds received require reconciliation evidence
[ ] All autonomous runs have evidence
[ ] Expo app works on Android
[ ] Expo app works on iOS
[ ] Owner authentication passes
[ ] Production deployment is verified
[ ] GitHub HEAD matches production
[ ] /health returns HTTP 200 and live commit
[ ] APK is provided
[ ] Architecture map is delivered
[ ] Final audit report is delivered

==================================================
15. FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT
==================================================

Do not respond with “completed,” “verified,” or “live” without evidence.

Return exactly:

1. EXECUTIVE RESULT
2. REAL-DATA COUNTS
3. INVESTOR AUDIT RESULTS
4. FINANCIAL RECONCILIATION
5. OUTREACH APPROVAL STATUS
6. AUTONOMOUS RUN AUDIT
7. AI ARCHITECTURE MAP
8. OWNER AUTHENTICATION TESTS
9. DATABASE AUDIT
10. GITHUB PROOF
11. RENDER PROOF
12. EXPO BUILD PROOF
13. APK DOWNLOAD ARTIFACT
14. PRODUCTION HEALTH PROOF
15. FAILED ITEMS
16. REMAINING ITEMS
17. FINAL ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST

For every completed item provide:

- Evidence
- Timestamp
- Trace ID
- Commit SHA
- Deployment ID where applicable
- Screenshot or log
- Production record reference

EXECUTE NOW. DO NOT ONLY CREATE A PLAN. DO NOT SEND INVESTOR OUTREACH UNTIL THE OWNER APPROVES THE verified production queue.
